Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 5  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner decided to navigate to the version 0.19 changelog based on incomplete information from the release history page, entering a loop (Rule 1). This decision misinterpreted upstream data by assuming the changelog for July 2017 would be under version 0.19 without verifying (Rule 2). This step initiated a loop that became increasingly difficult to recover from, as subsequent steps continued to rely on this incorrect assumption (Rule 3).
